# Data preparation

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(scales)

library(stringr)

)

  "Detected in one replicate only"
)

)

specificity_cols <- c("Species-specific" = "#669BBC", "Not species-specific" = "#FFB703")

  "Bacillus_subtilis", "Listeria_monocytogenes",
  "Staphylococcus_aureus", "Enterococcus_faecalis",
  "Lactobacillus_fermentum", "Salmonella_enterica",
  "Escherichia_coli", "Pseudomonas_aeruginosa"
)
species_cols <- c(

  "Saccharomyces_cerevisiae" = "#A7B58F",
  "Bacillus_subtilis" = "#D4D0C6",
  "Listeria_monocytogenes" = "#C8162B",
  "Staphylococcus_aureus" = "#7F0000",
  "Enterococcus_faecalis" = "#ED6A00",
  "Lactobacillus_fermentum" = "#FFB703",
  "Salmonella_enterica" = "#003B53",
  "Escherichia_coli" = "#669BBC",
  "Pseudomonas_aeruginosa" = "#8ECAE6"
)

species_from_id <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(x, regex("Cont|fgcz", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Contaminant",
    TRUE ~ str_extract(x, "^[^_]+_[^_]+")
  )
}

group_specificity <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(group) {
    members <- unlist(str_split(group, ";"), use.names = FALSE)
    taxa <- unique(na.omit(species_from_id(members)))
    if (length(taxa) == 1L) "Species-specific" else "Not species-specific"
  }, character(1))
}

theme_mock <- theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
```

# Replicate overlap and signal contribution

This figure separates peptide and protein identifications detected in both technical replicates from those detected in one replicate only, using identification counts and summed median-centred signal.

```{r replicate-overlap-and-signal, fig.width=12, fig.height=4.5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
peptide_presence <- peptide_raw_dat %>%
  group_by(Peptide_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Replicates = sum(!is.na(Peptide_Abundance)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Presence = if_else(
      N_Replicates == length(sample_order),
      presence_order[1],
      presence_order[2]
    )
  )

peptide_overlap <- peptide_raw_dat %>%
  left_join(
    peptide_presence %>% select(Peptide_ID, Presence),
    by = "Peptide_ID"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Peptide_Abundance), Peptide_Abundance > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = factor(Sample, levels = sample_order),
    Presence = factor(Presence, levels = presence_order)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(
    Median_Centered_Signal =
      Peptide_Abundance / median(Peptide_Abundance)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

protein_presence <- protein_raw_dat %>%
  group_by(Protein_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Replicates = sum(!is.na(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Presence = if_else(
      N_Replicates == length(sample_order),
      presence_order[1],
      presence_order[2]
    )
  )

protein_overlap <- protein_raw_dat %>%
  left_join(
    protein_presence %>% select(Protein_ID, Presence),
    by = "Protein_ID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ),
    Protein_Abundance_IBAQ > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = factor(Sample, levels = sample_order),
    Presence = factor(Presence, levels = presence_order)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(
    Median_Centered_Signal =
      Protein_Abundance_IBAQ /
      median(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

replicate_overlap_source <- bind_rows(
  peptide_overlap %>%
    count(Sample, Presence, name = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Peptide",
      Metric = "Identification count"
    ),

  peptide_overlap %>%
    group_by(Sample, Presence) %>%
    summarise(
      Value = sum(Median_Centered_Signal),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Peptide",
      Metric = "Median-centered abundance"
    ),

  protein_overlap %>%
    count(Sample, Presence, name = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Protein",
      Metric = "Identification count"
    ),

  protein_overlap %>%
    group_by(Sample, Presence) %>%
    summarise(
      Value = sum(Median_Centered_Signal),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Protein",
      Metric = "Median-centered iBAQ"
    )
) %>%
  select(Data_Level, Metric, Sample, Presence, Value)

replicate_overlap_statistics <- bind_rows(
  peptide_presence %>%
    count(Presence, name = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Peptide",
      Metric = "Identifications"
    ),

  protein_presence %>%
    count(Presence, name = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Protein",
      Metric = "Identifications"
    ),

  peptide_overlap %>%
    group_by(Presence) %>%
    summarise(
      Value = sum(Median_Centered_Signal),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Peptide",
      Metric = "Median-centered abundance"
    ),

  protein_overlap %>%
    group_by(Presence) %>%
    summarise(
      Value = sum(Median_Centered_Signal),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Protein",
      Metric = "Median-centered iBAQ"
    )
) %>%
  group_by(Data_Level, Metric) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(Value),
    Percentage = 100 * Value / Total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(
  replicate_overlap_source,
  "Results/Replicate_Overlap/Replicate_Overlap_Source_Data.csv"
)

write_csv(

  "Results/Replicate_Overlap/Replicate_Overlap_Summary_Statistics.csv"
)
```

# Signal distributions and quantitative reproducibility

Raw and median-centred signal distributions are compared between replicates, followed by peptide- and protein-level correlations for features quantified in both runs.

```{r signal-distributions-and-reproducibility, fig.width=14, fig.height=7.5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
peptide_distribution <- peptide_raw_dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(Peptide_Abundance), Peptide_Abundance > 0) %>%
  transmute(Data_Level = "Peptides", Sample, Log10_Signal = log10(Peptide_Abundance)) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(Centered_Log10_Signal = Log10_Signal - median(Log10_Signal)) %>%
  ungroup()

protein_distribution <- protein_raw_dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ), Protein_Abundance_IBAQ > 0) %>%
  transmute(Data_Level = "Proteins", Sample, Log10_Signal = log10(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ)) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(Centered_Log10_Signal = Log10_Signal - median(Log10_Signal)) %>%
  ungroup()

reproducibility_distribution_source <- bind_rows(peptide_distribution, protein_distribution)

make_pairs <- function(data, id_col, abundance_col) {
  data %>%
    select(Feature_ID = all_of(id_col), Sample, Signal = all_of(abundance_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Signal), Signal > 0) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = Signal) %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(sample_order), ~ !is.na(.x))) %>%
    transmute(
      Feature_ID,
      Replicate_1 = .data[[sample_order[1]]],
      Replicate_2 = .data[[sample_order[2]]],
      Log10_Replicate_1 = log10(Replicate_1),
      Log10_Replicate_2 = log10(Replicate_2)
    )
}

peptide_pairs <- make_pairs(peptide_raw_dat, "Peptide_ID", "Peptide_Abundance")
protein_pairs <- make_pairs(protein_raw_dat, "Protein_ID", "Protein_Abundance_IBAQ")

summarise_reproducibility <- function(pairs, level) {
  pearson <- cor.test(pairs$Log10_Replicate_1, pairs$Log10_Replicate_2, method = "pearson")
  spearman <- cor.test(pairs$Log10_Replicate_1, pairs$Log10_Replicate_2,
                       method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  model <- lm(Log10_Replicate_2 ~ Log10_Replicate_1, data = pairs)
  tibble(
    Data_Level = level,
    N = nrow(pairs),
    Pearson_r = unname(pearson$estimate),
    Pearson_p = pearson$p.value,
    Spearman_rho = unname(spearman$estimate),
    Spearman_p = spearman$p.value,
    Intercept = unname(coef(model)[1]),
    Slope = unname(coef(model)[2]),
    R_squared = summary(model)$r.squared,
    Adjusted_R_squared = summary(model)$adj.r.squared
  )
}

peptide_model <- lm(Log10_Replicate_2 ~ Log10_Replicate_1, data = peptide_pairs)
protein_model <- lm(Log10_Replicate_2 ~ Log10_Replicate_1, data = protein_pairs)
reproducibility_statistics <- bind_rows(
  summarise_reproducibility(peptide_pairs, "Peptide"),
  summarise_reproducibility(protein_pairs, "Protein")
)

write_csv(
  reproducibility_distribution_source,
  "Results/Quantitative_Reproducibility/Signal_Distribution_Source_Data.csv"
)
write_csv(
  peptide_pairs,
  "Results/Quantitative_Reproducibility/Peptide_Replicate_Pairs.csv"
)
write_csv(
  protein_pairs,
  "Results/Quantitative_Reproducibility/Protein_Replicate_Pairs.csv"
)
write_tsv(
  reproducibility_statistics,
  "Results/Quantitative_Reproducibility/Reproducibility_Statistics.tsv"
)

model_lines <- capture.output({
  cat("MockD6300 technical-replicate reproducibility\n")
  cat("Matched positive signals; log10 transformation; ordinary least-squares models.\n\n")
  cat("PEPTIDES\n")
  print(summary(peptide_model))
  print(confint(peptide_model))
  cat("\nPROTEINS\n")
  print(summary(protein_model))
  print(confint(protein_model))
})
write_lines(
  model_lines,
  "Results/Quantitative_Reproducibility/Reproducibility_Model_Summaries.txt"
)

density_panel <- function(data, level, variable, title, x_label) {
  ggplot(filter(data, Data_Level == level), aes(x = .data[[variable]], colour = Sample, fill = Sample)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = replicate_cols) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = replicate_cols) +
    labs(title = title, x = x_label, y = "Density") +
    theme_mock
}

scatter_panel <- function(pairs, level, colour) {
  stat_row <- filter(reproducibility_statistics, Data_Level == level)
  annotation <- sprintf(
    "n = %s\nr = %.3f\nrho = %.3f\nR^2 = %.3f",
    comma(stat_row$N), stat_row$Pearson_r, stat_row$Spearman_rho, stat_row$R_squared
  )
  ggplot(pairs, aes(Log10_Replicate_1, Log10_Replicate_2)) +
    geom_point(colour = colour, alpha = 0.35, size = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = annotation, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.15, size = 3) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(level, "s"),
      x = expression(log[10]~"signal, replicate 1"),
      y = expression(log[10]~"signal, replicate 2")
    ) +
    theme_mock
}

peptide_raw_distribution_plot <- density_panel(
  reproducibility_distribution_source, "Peptides", "Log10_Signal",

)
protein_raw_distribution_plot <- density_panel(

peptide_centered_distribution_plot <- density_panel(

peptide_reproducibility_plot <- scatter_panel(peptide_pairs, "Peptide", "#669BBC")

distribution_plots <- wrap_plots(
```

# Quality filtering and species specificity

Successive filtering stages are evaluated for species-specific assignment. The retained protein counts and iBAQ signal are then compared with excluded non-species-specific assignments.

```{r quality-filtering-and-species-specificity, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
############################################################
# Quality filtering and species specificity
#
# Purpose:
#   Follow identifications through three filtering stages:
#     1. 1% peptide-level FDR
#     2. 1% peptide- and protein-level FDR
#     3. At least two peptides per protein group
#
# Contaminant handling:
#   Protein groups containing contaminant database entries are
#   removed before any filtering statistics are calculated.
#   All counts and percentages therefore describe only proteins
#   and peptides assigned to the mock-community organisms.
#
# Required input:
#   diann_dat  = DIA-NN report loaded from diann-report.tsv
#   protein_dat = final combined protein table
#
# Required shared objects:
#   specificity_cols
#   theme_mock
############################################################


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Helper functions
# ----------------------------------------------------------

contains_contaminant <- function(x) {
  str_detect(
    coalesce(as.character(x), ""),
    regex(
      "(^|;)Cont_|fgcz|\\|Cont_",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    )
  )
}


remove_diann_contaminants <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!contains_contaminant(Protein.Group))
}


remove_processed_contaminants <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(
      !str_detect(
        coalesce(as.character(Species_ID), ""),
        regex("^Cont_|fgcz", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ),
      !contains_contaminant(Protein_Group)
    )
}


group_specificity_interest <- function(protein_groups) {
  vapply(
    protein_groups,
    function(group) {
      protein_ids <- str_split(
        coalesce(group, ""),
        ";",
        simplify = FALSE
      )[[1]]

      species_ids <- protein_ids %>%
        str_trim() %>%
        str_extract("^[^_]+_[^_]+") %>%
        na.omit() %>%
        unique()

      if (length(species_ids) == 1L) {
        "Species-specific"
      } else {
        "Not species-specific"
      }
    },
    character(1)
  )
}


classify_diann_peptides <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(Stripped.Sequence) %>%
    summarise(
      Protein_Group = paste(
        unique(Protein.Group),
        collapse = ";"
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      Feature_ID = Stripped.Sequence,
      Protein_Group,
      Specificity =
        group_specificity_interest(Protein_Group)
    )
}


classify_diann_proteins <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    distinct(Protein.Group) %>%
    transmute(
      Feature_ID = Protein.Group,
      Protein_Group = Protein.Group,
      Specificity =
        group_specificity_interest(Protein_Group)
    )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Remove contaminants before filtering
# ----------------------------------------------------------

diann_interest <- diann_dat %>%
  remove_diann_contaminants()

protein_final <- protein_dat %>%
  remove_processed_contaminants() %>%
  mutate(
    Specificity =
      group_specificity_interest(Protein_Group)
  ) %>%
  distinct(Protein_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Apply the successive DIA-NN filtering stages
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Stage 1: peptide-level FDR below 1%
diann_peptide_fdr <- diann_interest %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Q.Value),
    Q.Value < 0.01
  )


# Stage 2: peptide- and protein-level FDR below 1%
diann_protein_fdr <- diann_peptide_fdr %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Lib.PG.Q.Value),
    !is.na(PG.Q.Value),
    Lib.PG.Q.Value < 0.01,
    PG.Q.Value < 0.01
  )


# Stage 3: at least two distinct peptides per protein group
diann_two_peptides <- diann_protein_fdr %>%
  group_by(Protein.Group) %>%
  filter(
    n_distinct(Stripped.Sequence) >= 2
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Classify peptides and proteins at every stage
# ----------------------------------------------------------

peptide_stage1 <- classify_diann_peptides(
  diann_peptide_fdr
)

peptide_stage2 <- classify_diann_peptides(
  diann_protein_fdr
)

peptide_stage3 <- classify_diann_peptides(
  diann_two_peptides
)


protein_stage1 <- classify_diann_proteins(
  diann_peptide_fdr
)

protein_stage2 <- classify_diann_proteins(
  diann_protein_fdr
)

protein_stage3 <- classify_diann_proteins(
  diann_two_peptides
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Prepare stacked-bar source data
# ----------------------------------------------------------

filter_order <- c(
  "1% peptide FDR",
  "1% protein FDR",
  ">=2 peptides per protein"
)

specificity_order <- c(
  "Species-specific",
  "Not species-specific"
)


filtering_source <- bind_rows(
  peptide_stage1 %>%
    count(Specificity, name = "Count") %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Peptides",
      Filter = filter_order[1]
    ),

  peptide_stage2 %>%
    count(Specificity, name = "Count") %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Peptides",
      Filter = filter_order[2]
    ),

  peptide_stage3 %>%
    count(Specificity, name = "Count") %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Peptides",
      Filter = filter_order[3]
    ),

  protein_stage1 %>%
    count(Specificity, name = "Count") %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Proteins",
      Filter = filter_order[1]
    ),

  protein_stage2 %>%
    count(Specificity, name = "Count") %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Proteins",
      Filter = filter_order[2]
    ),

  protein_stage3 %>%
    count(Specificity, name = "Count") %>%
    mutate(
      Data_Level = "Proteins",
      Filter = filter_order[3]
    )
) %>%
  complete(
    Data_Level,
    Filter,
    Specificity,
    fill = list(Count = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Data_Level, Filter) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(Count),
    Percentage = 100 * Count / Total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Filter = factor(
      Filter,
      levels = filter_order
    ),
    Specificity = factor(
      Specificity,
      levels = specificity_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Data_Level,
    Filter,
    Specificity
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Calculate final protein retention
#
# Species-specific proteins are retained.
# Non-species-specific protein groups are excluded.
# Contaminants have already been removed.
# ----------------------------------------------------------

specificity_retention_source <- bind_rows(
  protein_final %>%
    mutate(
      Status = if_else(
        Specificity == "Species-specific",
        "Species-specific",
        "Excluded"
      )
    ) %>%
    count(Status, name = "Value") %>%
    mutate(Metric = "Protein IDs"),

  protein_final %>%
    mutate(
      Status = if_else(
        Specificity == "Species-specific",
        "Species-specific",
        "Excluded"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(Status) %>%
    summarise(
      Value = sum(
        Protein_Abundance_IBAQ,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Metric = "Protein abundance")
) %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(Value),
    Percentage = 100 * Value / Total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Export figure source data and statistics
# ----------------------------------------------------------

output_directory <-
  "Results/Species_Specificity_Filtering"

dir.create(
  output_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


write_csv(
  filtering_source,
  file.path(
    output_directory,
    "Filtering_Source_Data.csv"
  )
)


write_csv(
  specificity_retention_source,
  file.path(
    output_directory,
    "Species_Specificity_Retention_Source_Data.csv"
  )
)


write_csv(
  specificity_retention_source %>%
    select(
      Metric,
      Status,
      Value,
      Total,
      Percentage
    ),
  file.path(
    output_directory,
    "Filtering_Summary_Statistics.csv"
  )
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Stacked-bar plotting function
#
# reverse = TRUE places the yellow non-specific segment
# above the blue species-specific segment.
# ----------------------------------------------------------

filter_panel <- function(level) {
  panel_data <- filtering_source %>%
    filter(Data_Level == level)

  if (level == "Peptides") {
    y_scale <- scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 50000, 10000),
      limits = c(0, 50000),
      labels = comma,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    )
  } else {
    y_scale <- scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 12500, 2500),
      limits = c(0, 12500),
      labels = comma,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    )
  }

  ggplot(
    panel_data,
    aes(
      x = Filter,
      y = Count,
      fill = Specificity
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.7,
      position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = sprintf(
          "%s\n(%.1f%%)",
          comma(Count),
          Percentage
        )
      ),
      position = position_stack(
        vjust = 0.5,
        reverse = TRUE
      ),
      size = 2.7
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = specificity_cols,
      breaks = specificity_order,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    y_scale +
    labs(
      title = level,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_mock +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 38,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Retention-pie plotting function
# ----------------------------------------------------------

pie_panel <- function(metric, title) {
  pie_data <- specificity_retention_source %>%
    filter(Metric == metric) %>%
    mutate(
      Status = factor(
        Status,
        levels = c(
          "Species-specific",
          "Excluded"
        )
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    pie_data,
    aes(
      x = "",
      y = Value,
      fill = Status
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 1,
      colour = "#555555",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = sprintf(
          "%s\n%.1f%%",
          Status,
          Percentage
        )
      ),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Species-specific" = "#8ECAE6",
        "Excluded" = "#D0D0D0"
      )
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Combine the two filtering panels
#
# A single collected legend is placed below both bar plots.
# ----------------------------------------------------------

filtering_bar_plots <- wrap_plots(
  filter_panel("Peptides"),
  filter_panel("Proteins"),
  ncol = 1,
  guides = "collect"
) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center"
  )


retention_pie_plots <- wrap_plots(
  pie_panel(
    "Protein IDs",
    "Protein IDs retained vs excluded"
  ),
  pie_panel(
    "Protein abundance",
    "Protein abundance retained vs excluded"
  ),
  ncol = 1
)


quality_filtering_plot <- wrap_plots(
  filtering_bar_plots,
  retention_pie_plots,
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(2.2, 1)
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Export the combined figure
# ----------------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  file.path(
    output_directory,
    "Quality_Filtering_and_Species_Specificity.png"
  ),
  quality_filtering_plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)


quality_filtering_plot

############################################################
# SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE 13 — SOURCE DATA
############################################################

source_dir <- paste0(
  "C:/SynologyDrive/PhD/Projects/SpringBloom2021/",
  "DataAnalysis_SpringBloom2021/Source_Data_Supplement"
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# A) Filtering bars
# ----------------------------------------------------------

Suppl_Figure_13_Bars <- filtering_source %>%
  transmute(
    Data_Level,
    Filter = as.character(Filter),
    Specificity = as.character(Specificity),
    Count,
    Total,
    Percentage
  )

write_csv(
  Suppl_Figure_13_Bars,
  file.path(
    source_dir,
    "Suppl_Figure_13_Bars.csv"
  )
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# B) Retention pies
# ----------------------------------------------------------

Suppl_Figure_13_Pies <- specificity_retention_source %>%
  transmute(
    Metric,
    Status,
    Value,
    Total,
    Percentage
  )

write_csv(
  Suppl_Figure_13_Pies,
  file.path(
    source_dir,
    "Suppl_Figure_13_Pies.csv"
  )
)
```

# Community composition and proteome recovery

The theoretical community is compared with detected-protein counts and summed iBAQ abundance. Detected proteins are also expressed relative to each organism's reference coding capacity.

```{r}
############################################################
# Community composition and detected proteome coverage
#
# The community-composition legend is generated from
# species_dat and reports:
#
#   Species name (G+/G-, genome size in Mbp)
#
# For the two fungi, Gram status is replaced by "Yeast".
# Because species_dat$bases is missing for both yeasts, their
# D6300 reference genome sizes are supplied explicitly:
#
#   Saccharomyces cerevisiae: 12.1 Mbp
#   Cryptococcus neoformans: 18.9 Mbp
#
# The coverage plot reports:
#   - detected and not-detected protein counts inside each bar
#   - detected-proteome percentage above each bar
############################################################
library(tibble)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare species metadata and legend labels
# ----------------------------------------------------------

species_reference <- species_dat %>%
  transmute(
    Species = str_replace_all(organism, " ", "_"),
    Organism = organism,
    Gram,
    Genome_Size_Mb = case_when(
      !is.na(bases) ~ bases / 1e6,
      organism == "Saccharomyces cerevisiae" ~ 12.1,
      organism == "Cryptococcus neoformans" ~ 18.9,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Reference_Proteins = coalesce(CDS, gene),
    Organism_Type = case_when(
      organism %in% c(
        "Saccharomyces cerevisiae",
        "Cryptococcus neoformans"
      ) ~ "Yeast",
      Gram == "+" ~ "G+",
      Gram == "-" ~ "G-",
      TRUE ~ "Gram status unavailable"
    ),
    Legend_Label = sprintf(
      "%s (%s, %.1f Mbp)",
      Organism,
      Organism_Type,
      Genome_Size_Mb
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Species %in% species_order)


species_legend_labels <- species_reference %>%
  select(Species, Legend_Label) %>%
  deframe()


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define the theoretical community composition
# ----------------------------------------------------------

theoretical <- tibble(
  Species = species_order,
  Relative_Contribution = c(
    0.02,
    0.02,
    rep(0.12, 8)
  )
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Select species-specific detected proteins
# ----------------------------------------------------------

detected_species <- protein_dat %>%
  mutate(
    Species = species_from_id(Species_ID),
    Specificity = group_specificity(Protein_Group)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Specificity == "Species-specific",
    Species %in% species_order
  ) %>%
  distinct(Protein_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Calculate detected-protein contributions
# ----------------------------------------------------------

detected_counts <- detected_species %>%
  count(Species, name = "Value") %>%
  mutate(
    Relative_Contribution = Value / sum(Value)
  )


detected_abundance <- detected_species %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    Value = sum(
      Protein_Abundance_IBAQ,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Relative_Contribution = Value / sum(Value)
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Prepare community-composition source data
# ----------------------------------------------------------

community_composition_source <- bind_rows(
  theoretical %>%
    mutate(
      Community_Measure = "Theoretical",
      Value = Relative_Contribution
    ),

  detected_counts %>%
    mutate(
      Community_Measure = "Proteins detected"
    ),

  detected_abundance %>%
    mutate(
      Community_Measure = "Protein abundance"
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = factor(
      Species,
      levels = species_order
    ),
    Community_Measure = factor(
      Community_Measure,
      levels = c(
        "Theoretical",
        "Proteins detected",
        "Protein abundance"
      )
    )
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Calculate detected proteome coverage
# ----------------------------------------------------------

reference_counts <- species_reference %>%
  select(
    Species,
    Organism,
    Organism_Type,
    Gram,
    Genome_Size_Mb,
    Reference_Proteins
  )


proteome_recovery_source <- reference_counts %>%
  left_join(
    detected_counts %>%
      select(
        Species,
        Detected_Proteins = Value
      ),
    by = "Species"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Detected_Proteins = replace_na(
      Detected_Proteins,
      0L
    ),
    Not_Detected = pmax(
      Reference_Proteins - Detected_Proteins,
      0
    ),
    Recovery_Percentage =
      100 * Detected_Proteins / Reference_Proteins,
    Species = factor(
      Species,
      levels = rev(species_order)
    )
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Calculate summary statistics and models
# ----------------------------------------------------------

composition_wide <- community_composition_source %>%
  select(
    Species,
    Community_Measure,
    Relative_Contribution
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Community_Measure,
    values_from = Relative_Contribution
  )


composition_model <- lm(
  `Protein abundance` ~ Theoretical,
  data = composition_wide
)


coverage_model <- lm(
  Recovery_Percentage ~ Reference_Proteins,
  data = proteome_recovery_source
)


community_recovery_statistics <- tibble(
  Analysis = c(
    "Theoretical vs detected protein abundance",
    "Proteome recovery vs reference proteome size"
  ),
  N = c(
    nrow(composition_wide),
    nrow(proteome_recovery_source)
  ),
  Pearson_r = c(
    cor(
      composition_wide$Theoretical,
      composition_wide$`Protein abundance`,
      use = "complete.obs"
    ),
    cor(
      proteome_recovery_source$Reference_Proteins,
      proteome_recovery_source$Recovery_Percentage,
      use = "complete.obs"
    )
  ),
  R_squared = c(
    summary(composition_model)$r.squared,
    summary(coverage_model)$r.squared
  )
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Export source data and statistics
# ----------------------------------------------------------

output_directory <-
  "Results/Community_Proteome_Recovery"

dir.create(
  output_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


write_csv(
  community_composition_source,
  file.path(
    output_directory,
    "Community_Composition_Source_Data.csv"
  )
)


write_csv(
  proteome_recovery_source,
  file.path(
    output_directory,
    "Proteome_Recovery_Source_Data.csv"
  )
)


write_csv(
  species_reference,
  file.path(
    output_directory,
    "Species_Reference_and_Legend_Data.csv"
  )
)


write_csv(
  community_recovery_statistics,
  file.path(
    output_directory,
    "Community_Recovery_Summary_Statistics.csv"
  )
)


community_recovery_model_lines <- capture.output({
  cat(
    paste0(
      "COMMUNITY COMPOSITION\n",
      "Protein abundance ~ theoretical contribution\n\n"
    )
  )
  print(summary(composition_model))
  print(confint(composition_model))

  cat(
    paste0(
      "\nPROTEOME RECOVERY\n",
      "Recovery percentage ~ reference proteome size\n\n"
    )
  )
  print(summary(coverage_model))
  print(confint(coverage_model))
})


write_lines(
  community_recovery_model_lines,
  file.path(
    output_directory,
    "Community_Recovery_Model_Summaries.txt"
  )
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Community-composition stacked bars
# ----------------------------------------------------------

community_composition_plot <- ggplot(
  community_composition_source,
  aes(
    x = Community_Measure,
    y = Relative_Contribution,
    fill = Species
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.65,
    colour = "#555555",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = species_cols,
    breaks = rev(species_order),
    labels = species_legend_labels[rev(species_order)],
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Community overview",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative contribution"
  ) +
  theme_mock +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 0,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.42, "cm")
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Prepare stacked proteome-coverage data
# ----------------------------------------------------------

recovery_long <- proteome_recovery_source %>%
  select(
    Species,
    Detected_Proteins,
    Not_Detected
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Detected_Proteins,
      Not_Detected
    ),
    names_to = "Status",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Status = factor(
      Status,
      levels = c(
        "Detected_Proteins",
        "Not_Detected"
      )
    )
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Detected proteome coverage
#
# Small numbers inside each stacked segment report the
# absolute detected and not-detected protein counts.
# Percentages above the bars report proteome recovery.
# ----------------------------------------------------------

proteome_coverage_plot <- ggplot(
  recovery_long,
  aes(
    x = Species,
    y = Count,
    fill = Status
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    colour = "#555555",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = comma(
        Count,
        accuracy = 1
      )
    ),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 2.0,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = proteome_recovery_source,
    aes(
      x = Species,
      y = Reference_Proteins,
      label = sprintf(
        "%.1f%%",
        Recovery_Percentage
      )
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 2.6,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Detected_Proteins" = "#1F78B4",
      "Not_Detected" = "#CFCFCF"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "Detected_Proteins",
      "Not_Detected"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Detected proteins",
      "Not detected"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = comma,
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.08)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Detected proteome coverage",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Gene count"
  ) +
  theme_mock +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 7
    ),
    legend.position = "right"
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Assemble and export the combined figure
# ----------------------------------------------------------

community_proteome_recovery_plot <-
  community_composition_plot +
  proteome_coverage_plot +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(1.15, 1.35)
  )


ggsave(
  file.path(
    output_directory,
    "Community_Composition_and_Proteome_Recovery.png"
  ),
  community_proteome_recovery_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)


community_proteome_recovery_plot

############################################################
# SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE 14 — SOURCE DATA
############################################################

source_dir <- paste0(
  "C:/SynologyDrive/PhD/Projects/SpringBloom2021/",
  "DataAnalysis_SpringBloom2021/Source_Data_Supplement"
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# A) Community composition
# ----------------------------------------------------------

Suppl_Figure_14_Community <- community_composition_source %>%
  transmute(
    Community_Measure = as.character(Community_Measure),
    Species = as.character(Species),
    Value,
    Relative_Contribution
  )

write_csv(
  Suppl_Figure_14_Community,
  file.path(
    source_dir,
    "Suppl_Figure_14_Community.csv"
  )
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# B) Proteome recovery
# ----------------------------------------------------------

Suppl_Figure_14_Recovery <- proteome_recovery_source %>%
  transmute(
    Species = as.character(Species),
    Organism,
    Organism_Type,
    Gram,
    Genome_Size_Mb,
    Reference_Proteins,
    Detected_Proteins,
    Not_Detected,
    Recovery_Percentage
  )

write_csv(
  Suppl_Figure_14_Recovery,
  file.path(
    source_dir,
    "Suppl_Figure_14_Recovery.csv"
  )
)
```
